The deploy to staging didn't complete successfully. Image `api:7f3c2e1` built, pushed, and the rollout was triggered, but `/healthz` returned 503 for the full 60s timeout, so the fix isn't confirmed working.

I don't know yet why it's failing. It could be a slow startup that needs more than 60s, a crash loop, or a bug in the fix itself. Staging is currently running the new image, so it may be serving errors.

Next I'd check `kubectl rollout status deployment/api` and the pod logs to see which it is. If you'd rather I roll back first, say so and I'll do it.
